I would like to conclude with the thought of Job, whose wife came to him with a tempting thought: "Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die. "But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? … "All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils, "My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit. "God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me. "My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live. … "For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?" (Job 2:9-10; 27:3-6, 8.)
